faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Goa Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Goa is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech. in Biotechnology with a qualified GATE score, or a B.Sc. and M.Sc. in Biology or an allied field with a qualified CSIR-UGC NET score. An M.Tech. in Biotechnology with a qualified GATE score is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post at IIT Goa.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a screening by a Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Goa?
faq.answer: The official website of IIT Goa is https://iitgoa.ac.in.
